analysis: Offline audit of all 30 nominal trials, truncated at each first terminal event

method.interval_scope: Only complete recorded intervals ending at or before terminal_time_s; the interval crossing termination is excluded.
method.event_scope: Main counts require both reception before the first collector mission_end and event sim_time_s at or before terminal_time_s.
method.late_event_scope: Events received after the collector mission_end but timestamped at or before terminal_time_s are retained only in late_preterminal_events audit fields; excluded from all main counts.
method.terminal_definition: Existing collector event and summary; no collision, bounds or success classification is recomputed.
method.interpretation: Execution-model consistency and collision-free goal-reaching success are separate evidence. This audit does not identify a single cause of collision or out-of-bounds failure.
